analogy.rationale: Mucolytic agents like N-acetylcysteine act extracellularly on mucus disulfide bonds and have no annotated intracellular target in these cells, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response; the listed analogs are similarly non-specific or extracellular-acting classes with minimal expected transcriptomic impact.
